text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, that's not it...! ...Umm... 
everyone back in Tomakomai has been 
sending me so many messages cheering me 
up...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Those cheers... they're so warm... I... 
ah...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I—I will definitely find a way to repay 
you...!
choice_data_list: Let's keep at it at our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course! With the power I just received, 
I'm gonna train harder and harder!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I want to make sure... everyone 
gets to say "congratulations"...!
